purpose: Preserve source facial diversity during adaptation, starting before observed control contraction
interpretation: Controlled feasibility test, not full convergence budget. Same seed, dataset and adversarial settings as control; independent CDC latent stream. CDC helper and trainer hashes recorded by trainer.
quality_gate: Review matched fixed latents and unseen samples for facial integrity, adult male priest appearance, collars, no hats and varied identities. Do not deploy on loss/hash evidence alone.
hardware: Local Apple M5 Pro MPS, concurrent control run; do not interpret wall time as isolated benchmark.
